verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.19
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 6.19

verses.pali: 2. Sāraṇīyavagga
verses.english: 2. Warm-hearted

verses.pali: Paṭhamamaraṇassatisutta
verses.english: Mindfulness of Death (1st)

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying at Ñātika in the brick house.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,

verses.pali: “bhikkhavo”ti.
verses.english: “Mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Bhadante”ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Venerable sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “maraṇassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when mindfulness of death is developed and cultivated it’s very fruitful and beneficial. It has freedom from death as its objective and culmination.

verses.pali: Bhāvetha no tumhe, bhikkhave, maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: But do you develop mindfulness of death?”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, one of the mendicants said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahaṁ kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ rattindivaṁ jīveyyaṁ, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live for another day and night, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Aññataropi kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Another mendicant said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahampi kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I too develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ divasaṁ jīveyyaṁ, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live for another day, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Aññataropi kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Another mendicant said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahampi kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I too develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ ekapiṇḍapātaṁ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live as long as it takes to eat a meal of almsfood, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Aññataropi kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Another mendicant said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahampi kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I too develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live as long as it takes to chew and swallow four or five mouthfuls, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Aññataropi kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Another mendicant said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahampi kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I too develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ ekaṁ ālopaṁ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live as long as it takes to chew and swallow a single mouthful, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Aññataropi kho bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Another mendicant said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahampi kho, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, I too develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin”ti?
verses.english: “But mendicant, how do you develop it?”

verses.pali: “Idha mayhaṁ, bhante, evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “In this case, sir, I think:

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ assasitvā vā passasāmi passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: ‘Oh, if I’d only live as long as it takes to breathe out after breathing in, or to breathe in after breathing out, I’d focus on the Buddha’s instructions and I could really achieve a lot.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho ahaṁ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I develop mindfulness of death.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, bhagavā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
verses.english: When this was said, the Buddha said to those mendicants:

verses.pali: “yo cāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
verses.english: “As to the mendicants who develop mindfulness of death by wishing

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ rattindivaṁ jīveyyaṁ, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: to live for a day and night …

verses.pali: Yo cāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
‘aho vatāhaṁ divasaṁ jīveyyaṁ, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: or to live for a day …

verses.pali: Yo cāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ ekapiṇḍapātaṁ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: or to live as long as it takes to eat a meal of almsfood …

verses.pali: Yo cāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: or to live as long as it takes to chew and swallow four or five mouthfuls—

verses.pali: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū pamattā viharanti dandhaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāventi āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: these are called mendicants who live negligently. They slackly develop mindfulness of death for the ending of defilements.

verses.pali: Yo ca khvāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
verses.english: But as to the mendicants who develop mindfulness of death by wishing

verses.pali: ‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ ekaṁ ālopaṁ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: to live as long as it takes to chew and swallow a single mouthful …

verses.pali: Yo cāyaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāveti:
‘aho vatāhaṁ tadantaraṁ jīveyyaṁ yadantaraṁ assasitvā vā passasāmi passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṁ manasi kareyyaṁ, bahu vata me kataṁ assā’ti.
verses.english: or to live as long as it takes to breathe out after breathing in, or to breathe in after breathing out—

verses.pali: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū appamattā viharanti tikkhaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāventi āsavānaṁ khayāya.
verses.english: these are called mendicants who live diligently. They keenly develop mindfulness of death for the ending of defilements.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, evaṁ sikkhitabbaṁ:
verses.english: So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘appamattā viharissāma, tikkhaṁ maraṇassatiṁ bhāvessāma āsavānaṁ khayāyā’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will live diligently. We will keenly develop mindfulness of death for the ending of defilements.’

verses.pali: Evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban”ti.
verses.english: That’s how you should train.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
